subject: Final go/no-go window, signature routing, and start-week alignment
messages:
From: Claire Barnes <claire@starlitretail.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Voss <alex.voss@procure-stone.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft and evaluation timeline — final decision window

Hi Grace,

Thanks for the draft MAP you and the team shared yesterday. Our Exec committee wants a tight gated timeline so we can lock calendar space and the project manager can assign resources. Two asks from our side: 

- Can you confirm the absolute latest date your legal/finance team needs to receive the countersigned SOW to make a 2027-08-02 start-week?
- We need a final go/no-go decision no later than Friday 2027-07-23 EOD PT to meet our internal procurement calendar.

Also attaching the internal procurement checklist we promised — it lists mandatory billing and data residency clauses. If Redwood needs alternative routing for signatures (DocuSign vs. internal e-sign), please flag.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Claire

Attachments: PO-checklist-Starlit.xlsx (attachment stub)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Barnes <claire@starlitretail.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 16 Jul 2027 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft and evaluation timeline — final decision window

Claire — thanks for the clear asks. Summarizing our proposed near-term plan so everyone has the same view: 

1) MAP and eval plan: we finished a third iteration this morning. I attached the MAP-v3.xlsx and a one-page EvaluationPlan-Starlit.pdf with pass/fail gates and sample prompts.
2) Signature routing: proposed flow is Redwood Legal (Kimberly) -> Redwood Finance (Ben) -> Starlit exec counter-sign. We can do DocuSign or encrypted PDF with wet-sign; we recommend DocuSign for speed.
3) Critical dates:
   - Redwood internal signoff needed by 2027-07-22 5pm PT to support a countersigned SOW back to you by 2027-07-26 (DocuSign envelope sent).
   - Final customer go/no-go by 2027-07-23 EOD PT (your calendar ask) — agrees with our rollout planning.
   - Target start-week: 2027-08-02 (onboarding and environment handoff).

Open items we still need from Starlit: confirmation on the billing address to appear on the SOW, and whether your security team requires an MFN data retention clause (they flagged this in the PO-checklist).

Next actions:
- Kimberly: do you see any blockers to the Redwood internal signoff timeline above?
- Ben: confirm finance OK with the proposed billing address section below so we can lock numbers.
- Claire: if DocuSign is acceptable, we'll prepare the envelope and map the signers; otherwise we'll share alternate routing.

Thanks — will follow up with the SOW draft (SOW-Starlit-draft.docx) by end of day Monday.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: MAP-v3.xlsx; EvaluationPlan-Starlit.pdf; SOW-Starlit-draft.docx (attachment stubs)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Claire Barnes <claire@starlitretail.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 09:55:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft and evaluation timeline — final decision window

On Fri, Jul 16, 2027 at 11:08 AM Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Kimberly: do you see any blockers to the Redwood internal signoff timeline above?

Grace / team — quick read-through notes: 
- SOW draft looks standard. I requested a minor change to the indemnity carve-out (commercially customary with the dataset-scope language) — I'll inline that to the draft and send my redline by EOD Tuesday 2027-07-20.
- No legal hold on the MFN data retention clause; will note the ask and propose softer language to align with our policy.

Ben — from Finance perspective: if billing address and payment terms remain Net-30, we do not need extra approval. If Starlit requires Net-60 or extended holdbacks, escalate and loop in Finance leadership.

Kimberly
General Counsel, Redwood Inference

(Internal note: I will prepare the DocuSign signer order: Kimberly Park -> Ben Carter -> Claire Barnes)

From: Claire Barnes <claire@starlitretail.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Voss <alex.voss@procure-stone.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft and evaluation timeline — final decision window

Thanks — that plan works for us. 

Confirming: Starlit Procurement will approve Net-30 and the billing address below is final (see PO attached). We're happy with DocuSign flow with the signer order you proposed. Our CFO asks that the onboarding kickoff be scheduled for the morning of Monday 2027-08-02 and that the Redwood onboarding team include one lead engineer for the first two days.

I've attached the PO-Starlit.pdf (signed internally) and asked our PM to reserve the 2027-08-02 slot — she will email the kickoff agenda once we receive the countersigned SOW.

On Tue, Jul 20, 2027 at 09:55 AM Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Kimberly — quick read-through notes...

Appreciate you moving quickly on the redline. Final request: can you please send the DocuSign envelope by 2027-07-26 so our legal team has a day for internal review before countersigning?

Claire
